column1: # Profile rows of the measured gf2 and gf2x paths (jit:53c5a8c0).
# One row is one path on one cell's fixture. Columns:
#   label      identity of the row in the profile record
#   cell       the study cell whose workload and seed this row reproduces
#   build      arms build variant: conservative (the crossover family's
#              portable executables) or native (the polynomial family's)
#   path       value of GF2_CROSSOVER_PATH; `batch` for rows whose case does
#              not read it, because the variable is mandatory for the crossover
#   case       the case JSON, character for character the workload and seed the
# Every case here is copied from the frozen addendum's cell of the same name,
# so a profile row measures the fixture its receipt measured. No row adds a
# size, a seed or a path the addenda do not declare.
